headline: Base Lines Stir Across Divided Fronts
war_summary: The latest ledger breaks the quiet noted in the previous edition: several sectors now show strategic-base movement in the last two hours. Linn Mercy is the busiest fresh front, recording 17 events in six hours and 23 in the day while remaining divided six Warden to five Colonial; Colonial captures account for 11 daily events. Deadlands remains fiercely contested at six Warden to five Colonial, with two events in the latest two hours and 17 across the day, while both casualty streams have surged. Marban Hollow continues to post active fighting and 13 daily base events, standing seven Colonial to one Warden. Endless Shore has also quickened, with four events in two hours and 16 in 24 hours, all eight current bases Colonial-held. Oarbreaker shows five events in the latest two hours, including a neutralized base, and now lists seven Colonial, one Warden, and one neutral position. Farranac Coast remains divided nine Colonial to two Warden, with two recent events and ten daily. Other sectors report combat or enlistment activity but no fresh base events, leaving the ownership race concentrated in these unsettled corridors.
